add_args_parser: add argparse arguments to configure adaptive attention span settings for a transformer model
create_adaptive_span: create an AdaptiveSpan module to manage variable-length attention masks for transformer layers
run_adaptive_span_forward: run the forward pass of AdaptiveSpan to apply adaptive attention masks to attention scores
test_trim_memory: test trim_memory to remove unnecessary key-value cache entries based on current attention span
summarize_get_loss: summarize get_loss to compute the adaptive span regularization loss from current size ratios
